Century Runner

Support This Game

This game was made for Godot Game Jam #97, with the theme "Imminent Doom."

LORE

hundred years, a chosen one is sent to the temple of the creator to touch the Star of Creation before a wave born from its destructive twin swallows it — and everything with it. This time, that chosen one is Ashwen. Guided by a fairy who can bend the temple's runes to his will, he races down a crumbling corridor between existence and oblivion. Fail, and the void claims it all. Succeed, and the world gets one more century.

ATTENTION!

I didn't have time to polish and work on the game's interface. The result is a short level, but it's fun.

CONTROLS:

  • Move: W,A,S,D
  • Fairy Move: Mouse
  • Interact with Runes: Mouse Wheel 
  • Unlock Fairy: Left Mouse Button

Game by Róger Goulart Music by xDeviruchi
